nodes.title: Sensor-space context
description: Multichannel EEG concatenated in time; configurable normalisation.

description: Disabled by default; enabled only by use_frozen_ica.

nodes.title: U-Net encoder
description: ReLU convolution / BatchNorm blocks and temporal downsampling.

nodes.title: U-Net decoder
description: Learned transposed convolutions; concatenate encoder skips.

nodes.title: Centre reconstruction
description: If ICA is enabled, inverse-project to sensors before selecting the centre.
Default: clean EEG; optional artifact = noisy centre - reconstructed clean centre.
